newsitem.title: USA: Handy & Harman stake lifted by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Handy & Harman stake lifted by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York investment manager Mario Gabelli said it raised its stake in Handy & Harman to 1,626,079 common, or 13.54 percent, from 12.30 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 205,039 common shares bought between November 27 and December 19 at prices ranging from $15.8750 to $18.75 per share. The Rye, New York company makes and sells precious metal products comprised of wired, rolled and powder products, provides refining services, publishes daily silver price list and silver review.
